name: Pork-Stuffed Pita with Creamy Apple Chutney & Parmesan Zucchini Spears

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
3 Gala apples
9 medium zucchini squash

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger, garlic, and onion; transfer to a medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
½ medium red onion

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, quarter, core, and small dice apples; add to the bowl with the ginger, garlic, and onion.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add ginger, garlic, onion, and apple. Cook, stirring occasionally, until golden and soft, 6-7 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Trim zucchini and quarter lengthwise, then halve crosswise; divide between two baking sheet pans. Drizzle with oil, season with spices, and sprinkle with Parmesan.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until zucchini is fork-tender, about 15 minutes; remove from oven.

When the apple is soft, add broth, vinegar, sugar, and spices to the skillet; stir to combine the chutney and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat. Once simmering, reduce heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened, about 10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
355 ml chicken or vegetable broth
2 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 ½ tsp brown sugar
¾ tsp coriander, ground
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board; thinly slice crosswise into bite-sized strips, then season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 pork chops, boneless
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the chutney is done, transfer to the reserved bowl and set aside. Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels and return to medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add pork and stir-fry until browned and cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, add yogurt to the chutney and stir to combine.
Using a clean cutting board, cut pitas in half and carefully open the pockets; stuff each pocket with creamy chutney and pork.
To serve, divide pitas and zucchini between plates. Enjoy!
